mentions.name: Legacy VBA macros modernization
mentions.description: This project untangles two decades of VBA macros that serve as the backbone of a company, with a vendor being sourced to modernize them into a more scalable and extensible system.
mentions.problem: Two decades of VBA macros that the company depends on are outdated and hard to make modern, scalable, or extensible.
mentions.source_excerpt: Sourcing a vendor to unravel 2 decades worth of VBA macros that are the backbone of a company so that we can make it more modern and scalable/extensible.

evidence.value: Sourcing a vendor to unravel 2 decades worth of VBA macros that are the backbone of a company so that we can make it more modern and scalable/extensible.
